title: archidendron multifoliolatum
intro: Archidendron multifoliolatum, commonly known as the Batai tree, is a species of flowering plant in the pea family. It is a deciduous tree native to the tropical forests of Southeast Asia, valued for its medicinal properties. The Batai tree has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory infections, due to its therapeutic actions as an anti-inflammatory and expectorant. The bioactive constituents of the Batai tree, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, are responsible for its health benefits, which include antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties.
